worker_steps: Inspect the current branch and data contract
Read this recipe using urban_python inspect_json
Run the declared script into a new run directory
Check exit_code and inspect the returned manifest
Attach the manifest, comparison table and figure exports using urban_attach_evidence
Prepare review with units, colour ranges, variable set, map fit scope and scientific interpretation questions
review_questions: Do all eight coefficients come from the full eight-predictor model at all seven supports?
Are physical bandwidth, coefficient units and colour ranges constant across comparable maps?
Is Table 2 OLS-only, with adaptive and fixed GWR comparisons kept separate?
Does the plot distinguish descriptive coefficients from held-out predictive scores?
Which spatial patterns require substantive human interpretation or further analysis?
human_authorization: No route selection or claim approval is implied by successful rendering.
